people.name: Sherif Elmasry
people.title: Founder & Managing Partner
bio: A business and technology leader with more than two decades of experience across corporate strategy, transformation, technology, business building and operating leadership.

His career spans large multinational organisations, growth businesses and entrepreneurial ventures across the UK, Middle East and Africa. He has led major transformation programmes, built and scaled businesses, worked with boards and executive teams, supported M&A and post-merger integration, and developed new ventures at the intersection of technology and commercial strategy.

At Comet, his work focuses on the economic implications of artificial intelligence: where it changes customer value, how work is organised, how enterprises operate and what new businesses become possible.
He also works with senior executives through executive education and leadership programmes, bringing together strategy, AI, innovation and practical operating experience.

experience.heading: Multinational transformation
experience.text: Led technology, governance and transformation work within major multinational environments, including complex cross-market organisations.

experience.heading: Operating leadership
experience.text: Held managing director and board-level operating responsibilities across businesses spanning multiple countries and more than 1,000 employees.

experience.heading: Business building
experience.text: Built and developed technology and services ventures across the UK and Middle East, including fundraising, partnerships, commercialisation and market entry.

experience.heading: Corporate development
experience.text: Worked across M&A, post-merger integration, strategic partnerships, joint ventures and investment-led growth.

experience.heading: Executive education
experience.text: Works with senior leaders through international executive education programmes focused on strategy, transformation, innovation and artificial intelligence.
